title: 第24章 国破山河在！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 唐逸前世作为特种兵，他的意识里只有进攻，从来就没有被动挨打。颜霜玉那个女人势利无比，竟然答应以资抵债，肯定是有问题的。而这种问题又不是什么绝密，带唐音下两次馆子，也就打听得差不多了。迎客楼面临倒闭，一部分原因是经营不善，但大部分的原因，还是因为天香楼的存在。天香楼背靠公主府，是京都最大的酒楼。天香楼的掌柜魏渊，宫里出来的太监，是个嗜酒如命的酒鬼！有这些信息，足够他做很多事情了。“小子，你这是想干嘛？”魏渊闻着酒香，肚子里面的馋虫馋得都打滚了，但他只是抬手拍了拍唐音的脑袋，却没有接她手中的酒坛。眼前的少年，让他越来越看不懂了。他之前说过要是眼前这少年不懂事，他会将其当成玩具好好的收拾收拾。但这里面的不懂事，是指通过一些见不得光的手段和天香楼争流。只要他本本分分地做他的生意，他也懒得管。毕竟天香楼作为京都第一酒楼，想要抢天香楼生意，做的什么美梦？唐逸拱了拱手，道：“晚辈刚刚接手迎客楼，接下来需要修缮一番，才能重新开门营业，修缮的这段时间，可能会有点点吵，还请公公海涵。”老太监老眼眯了一起，定定看了唐逸一会儿，颇感意外：“就这？”你这带着孩子带着酒，俨然一副要和我好好谈谈的样子，结果就为了这个？唐逸沉吟了一下，笑道：“也不全只为了这个，晚辈酒楼开业后，会与天香楼公平竞争客源，届时，还望公公勿要怪罪。”老太监愣了一下，笑得跟只狸猫似的。他身后的干儿子魏海也是对唐逸的话嗤之以鼻，冷笑一声道：“小子，你脑子没问题吧你？你觉得你那小小酒楼的生意，能比得过我们天香楼？”天香楼，上下共六层，连带后面园林在内，占地百余亩。越是往上，身份越高，想要上顶层，家里至少得有个正三品坐镇。而迎客楼呢？上下两层，占地不过几亩，也想和天香楼争锋？可笑！唐逸有自知之明，笑道：“自然是比不上，但好歹有点小秘方，能赚点养家糊口的小钱。”他从未想过要和天香楼对着干！一般像天香楼这种大酒楼，鱼龙混杂，客人都是来自五湖四海，非富即贵，完全是一个大型的情报基地。更别说还有皇族的背景！他就是穿越者，现在也不过是个光杆司令，还没办法玩得那么花。但是，就算短期内没办法玩得这么花，让一家酒楼生意兴隆，对他来说并不是什么难事。所以有些事还是说在前面比较好，免得到时候发生误会。“爷爷，我快坚持不住了。”唐音嘟着小嘴说道，她小手高高捧着酒壶，小手已经在颤抖了。魏海正想怒斥，老太监抬手阻止了他的话，笑眯眯接过唐音手中的酒坛。随即，在小女孩期待的眼神中，仰头喝了一口。酒水入唇，老太监只觉得整个口腔都辣翻天了，就像是火焰在嘴里燃烧一般。一口咽下，那种灼烧感瞬间席卷全身，仿佛要将他整个人点燃。“哈哈……好酒，这是什么酒？”老太监舒服长吟。以前也喝过不少好酒烈酒，但和唐逸送的这坛酒比起来，以前的那些好酒烈酒和水没什么区别！“蒸馏酒，晚辈的独门配方。”唐逸笑道。“爷爷，这可是我哥哥用了一大车酒煮出来的哦。”唐音眉眼弯弯，语气全是对哥哥的夸耀。老太监抬手敲了敲唐音的眉心，笑道：“小东西，原来这是几十坛酒煮出来的呀？你这把你哥哥的配方泄露给爷爷了呀。”唐音一呆，大眼睛瞪大，哎呀，真的是耶。“酒咱家收下了，以后多送几坛过来。”老太监笑着挥了挥手，下了逐客令。“晚辈告退。”唐逸识趣地带着唐音离开天香楼，唐音还不忘让老太监保守秘密。老太监笑着答应，魏海却是瞪大眼睛，难以置信，干爹在他们面前，还从未有这么好的脾气过。看着兄妹俩离去的背影，魏渊嘴角笑容渐渐收敛：“让人重新查一下唐逸，这个少年不简单……”魏海一愣，摇头道：“干爹，已经查过了，他在唐家没什么地位，位如弃子。”“弃子？”老太监老眼盯着魏海，目光犀利：“他杀过人，而且那种眼神，死在他手中的人绝对不是一两个，这种人物你说他是弃子？愚蠢！”魏海脸色剧变。怎么可能？传闻中一个养在府上的废物，怎么可能杀过人？这还不是最重要的，最重要的事……魏渊目光落在唐音的身上，那小女娃有陛下的玉佩啊！而这时，唐逸已经重新回到迎客楼。给十几名员工补发了工资，让他们联合选出了一个暂时暂代掌柜的家伙，将重新装修的事宜交给他们后，唐逸才带着唐音离开。只是刚出门，一辆马车便停在他的面前。车帘掀开，老王爷笑着冲他招了招手道：“唐家小子，上车。”唐逸抱着唐音上了马车，有些诧异道：“王爷不是要出城巡查吗？怎么又绕到这里来了？”老王爷笑道：“是要出城巡查，而且已经出城了，只是越想越不爽，凭啥狄苍那老匹夫能有那样的好诗词？”“小子，你也得给本王赋诗一首，否则本王可不饶你。”原来是为了这个，唐逸并不缺少诗词，道：“王爷需要什么样的诗词？说一下要求，我来作！”老王爷沉吟一下，道：“靖康耻，当时本王站在京都城墙上，看着往日繁华如今却断壁残垣，但老夫却无能为力……”唐逸明显看到说这话的时候，老王爷脸上原本平静的脸上杀意凛然，显然曾经的事，对他来说是挥之不去的耻辱！唐逸沉吟了一下，道：“明白了，那晚辈便以一首春望，赠与老王爷吧！”老王爷一愣：“等下，你现在作？不用想想？”唐逸摇头一笑：“不用。”随后，在福王惊呆的目光中，唐逸将诗缓缓吟诵出来。“国破山河在，城春草木深。”“感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心。”“烽火连三月，家书抵万金。”“白头搔更短，浑欲不胜簪。”……
content_en: As a special soldier in Tang Yi's previous life, his only thoughts were on offense and he never passively took beatings.That woman Yan Shuangyu is so snobbish that she even agreed to pay off her debt with assets. There must be something wrong with that.And this kind of question is not a top secret. I took Tang Yin to restaurants twice and I was able to find out enough about it.Yingke Building is facing closure, partly due to poor management, but most of the reason is due to the existence of Tianxiang Building.Tianxiang Restaurant is backed by Princess Mansion and is the largest restaurant in Kyoto.Wei Yuan, the shopkeeper of Tianxiang Tower, and the eunuch who came out of the palace, is an alcoholic who is addicted to alcohol!With this information, he is enough to do a lot of things."Boy, what do you want to do?" Wei Yuan smelled the aroma of the wine and felt so hungry that he was so hungry that he just raised his hand and patted Tang Yin on the head, but did not take the wine jar from her hand.The young man in front of him became increasingly difficult to understand.He had said before that if the boy in front of him was ignorant, he would treat him like a toy and take care of him.But the ignorance here refers to using some shady means to compete with Tianxiang Tower.As long as he was doing his business properly, he didn't bother to care.After all, Tianxianglou is the number one restaurant in Kyoto. What kind of dream do you have if you want to steal the business of Tianxianglou?Tang Yi cupped his hands and said: "Junior has just taken over the guest building. It needs to be repaired before it can reopen for business. During the repair period, it may be a little noisy. Please forgive me." The old eunuch narrowed his eyes and looked at Tang Yi for a while. He was surprised: "That's it?" You brought the child and the wine, as if you wanted to have a good talk with me, but this is what happened?Tang Yi pondered for a moment and said with a smile: "It's not all just for this. After Junior Restaurant opens, it will compete fairly with Tianxiang Restaurant for customers. By then, I hope my father-in-law won't blame me." The old eunuch was stunned for a moment and smiled like a civet cat.Behind him, his godson Wei Hai also sneered at Tang Yi's words and sneered: "Boy, are you okay with your brain? Do you think the business of your small restaurant can compare to our Tianxiang Tower?" Tianxiang Tower has six floors in total, including the garden behind it, covering an area of ​​more than 100 acres.The higher you go, the higher your status. If you want to get to the top, you must have at least a third-level official in your family.And what about the guest building?It has two floors, covering an area of ​​only a few acres. Do you want to compete with Tianxiang Tower?ridiculous!Tang Yi was self-aware and said with a smile: "Of course it can't compare, but at least I have a little secret recipe that can make a little money to support the family." He never thought about going against Tianxianglou!Generally, a large restaurant like Tianxiang Restaurant is a mixed bag of good and bad. The guests come from all over the world, and they are either rich or noble. It is completely a large-scale intelligence base.Not to mention having a royal background!He is a time traveler, and now he is just a polished commander, so he can't play so much.However, even if he can't have such a good time in the short term, it is not difficult for him to make a restaurant business prosperous.Therefore, it is better to talk about some things upfront to avoid misunderstandings later."Grandpa, I can't hold on anymore." Tang Yin pouted and said, holding the wine bottle high in her little hands, which were already trembling.When Wei Hai was about to reprimand, the old eunuch raised his hand to stop him and took the wine jar from Tang Yin's hand with a smile.Then, with the expectant eyes of the little girl, she raised her head and took a sip.As the wine entered his lips, the old eunuch felt that his whole mouth was burning, as if a fire was burning in his mouth.After swallowing it in one gulp, the burning sensation swept through his body instantly, as if it was about to set him on fire."Haha...good wine, what kind of wine is this?" the old eunuch groaned comfortably.I have drunk a lot of good wine and spirits before, but compared with this jar of wine given by Tang Yi, those good wines and spirits in the past are no different from water!"Distilled liquor, this junior's unique recipe." Tang Yi said with a smile."Grandpa, my brother spent a truckload of wine cooking this." Tang Yin's eyebrows were curved, and his tone was full of praise for his brother.The old eunuch raised his hand and knocked Tang Yin's forehead, and said with a smile: "Little one, it turns out that this is made from dozens of jars of wine? You have leaked your brother's recipe to grandpa." Tang Yin was stunned, and his big eyes widened, oh, it is really true."We've accepted the wine. We'll send a few more jars over in the future." The old eunuch smiled and waved his hand, giving the order to expel the guests."Junior, please take your leave." Tang Yi led Tang Yin out of Tianxiang Tower knowingly, but Tang Yin did not forget to ask the old eunuch to keep the secret.The old eunuch smiled and agreed, but Wei Hai's eyes widened in disbelief. His godfather had never had such a good temper in front of them.Watching the brothers and sisters leaving, Wei Yuan's smile gradually faded: "Let someone check Tang Yi again, this young man is not simple..." Wei Hai was stunned, shook his head and said: "Godfather, we have already checked. He has no status in the Tang family. He has no status in the Tang family."Abandoned son?"The old eunuch stared at Wei Hai with sharp eyes: "He has killed people, and with that kind of look, not only one or two people have died in his hands. Do you think he is an abandoned son?"Wei Hai's expression changed drastically.How is it possible?How could it be possible for a trash that was rumored to be raised in the house to have killed someone?This is not the most important thing, the most important thing... Wei Yuan's eyes fell on Tang Yin. That little girl has His Majesty's jade pendant!At this time, Tang Yi had returned to the guest building.After paying back wages to more than a dozen employees and asking them to jointly select a guy who would temporarily act as the shopkeeper, Tang Yicai left with Tang Yin after handing over the redecoration matters to them.But as soon as he went out, a carriage stopped in front of him.The car curtain opened, and the old prince smiled and waved to him: "Tang boy, get in the car." Tang Yi hugged Tang Yin and got on the carriage, and said with some surprise: "Isn't the prince going to go out for inspection in the city? Why are you here again?" The old princeHe smiled and said: "I am going out of the city for inspection, and I have already left the city. But the more I think about it, the more unhappy I am. Why can that old man Di Cang have such good poems?" "Boy, you have to write a poem for me, otherwise I will not spare you." Yuan.This is what I came for. Tang Yi was not short of poems and said: "What kind of poems does the prince need? Tell me your requirements and I will write them!" Tang Yi clearly saw that when he said this, the old prince's originally calm face was filled with murderous intent.
